name: Buling

tierList.prydwen: T2 Tower of Adversity, T3 Whimpering Wastes (Support)

kit.intro: 4-star Electro Rectifier support built on 'Trigram' resources (Mountain/Thunder, max 4) consumed via specific Heavy Attacks to reach an enhanced Ultimate that applies Electro Flare and buffs team Skill DMG (up to 25%, 50% at S6). Also heals off-field and buffs ATK via Rejuvenating Glow synergy.

skills.normalAttack: Hexagram Calls, Lightning Falls - 4-hit chain generating Trigrams on stages 2/4.
skills.resonanceSkill: In Shadow Thunder Stirs - Electro DMG + pulls enemies in, generates a Thunder Trigram.
skills.forte: Thunder Begets Life - Yin-Yang Balance state (from Minor Yin+Yang) upgrades Liberation to 'Harmony' variant with a Five Thunders Spell Array buffing team Skill DMG in escalating tiers via Intro casts.
skills.liberation: Flashing Thunder Spell (base) / Harmony (enhanced) - Electro DMG + team Skill DMG buff array.
skills.intro: Summon and Smite - Electro DMG + team heal.
skills.outro: Exorcism Spell - HoT to active character (18% ATK/s for 16s) + 15% team DMG Amplify for 30s (persists on swap).

echoSet: Rejuvenating Glow (5pc, +15% team ATK on heal)

mainStats.cost3: Electro DMG; Electro DMG > Energy Regen

teams.name: Best Team
teams.notes: Specializes in buffing Skill-DMG Main DPS; best niche is Carlotta/Phrolova teams, especially at S6 (50% Skill DMG Bonus).

rotation: Opener (no Intro): Basic 1-4 -> Skill -> Basic 4 -> Heavy: Twin Thunders -> Heavy: Mountain Over Thunder -> Ultimate (Harmony) -> Outro. Loop (with Intro): Intro -> Basic 1-2 -> Mid-air Attack -> Skill -> Basic 4 -> Heavy: Mountain Over Thunder -> Heavy: Twin Thunders -> Ultimate -> Outro.
communityNotes: Prydwen: solid free/easy 4-star generalist healer-support, generally an upgrade over Baizhi, but almost always outclassed by Verina as a generalist due to Verina's much shorter rotation; stands out specifically in Skill-DMG-focused teams (Carlotta, Phrolova) especially with S6 unlocked. Low priority pull for most endgame accounts that already own Verina/Shorekeeper.
